features: Explosion-proof, certification by SKU suffix: -C: cLC CSA (Ex d IIC T4, CAN CSA-C22.2 No.60079-0/-1, cert 11396-1S-CSA); -M: INMETRO (Ex d IIC T4 Gb, Ex tb IIIC T135C Db IP66/67, TUV 12.1080X / 12.1081X); -Z: cLCus C1/D1 (Class I Div 1 Groups B,C,D T4 / Class II Div 1 Groups E,F,G, cert 11671-1S / 11677-1S)
Electro-polished 316L stainless steel on all welded assemblies, A4 stainless fixings, toughened-glass window, 316L mirror-finish sun shield
150 dB WDR, HLC, BLC, SSDR, SSNR, gyro DIS, defog
Analytics: tampering, loitering, directional/virtual line, fog, enter/exit, appear/disappear, face, motion, shock detection
ONVIF Profile S/G/T, SUNAPI 2.0, Wisenet Open Platform
RS-485, alarm in 1 / out 2, audio in (mic/line) + line out (per -Z datasheet)
release_notes: Specs per official Hanwha Vision family datasheet (DataSheet_TNO-X6320EPT0-M_20260831_EN.pdf) covering TNO-X6320EP* (PoE, T0 temperature rating); the -Z SKU has its own matching datasheet. Merged SKUs TNO-X6320EPT0-C, TNO-X6320EPT0-M, TNO-X6320EPT0-Z (identical specs; suffix = certification region). Weight is the stated 'up to' maximum. Weight 8.54 kg per the TNO-X6320EPT0-Z datasheet (the -M sheet says up to 8.54 kg).

frigate.notes: Hanwha profiles: profile1=MJPEG, profile2=main, profile3=sub (default Wisenet profile layout); not yet verified on this model.
